form.title: Schedule P (540) — Alternative Minimum Tax and Credit Limitations — Residents

fields.label: Name or names as shown on Form 540 .
Your Social security number or Individual Taxpayer Identification number.
Part 1 . Line 1 . If you itemized deductions, go to line 2 . If you did not itemize deductions, enter your standard deduction from Form 540, line 18, and go to line 6 .
Line 2 . Medical and dental expenses. Enter the smaller of federal Schedule A (Form 1040), line 4, or 2½% (.025) of federal Form 1040 or 1040-SR, line 11b . See instructions.
Line 3 . Personal property taxes and real property taxes. See instructions.
Line 4 . Certain interest on a home mortgage not used to buy, build, or improve your home. See instructions.
Line 5 . Miscellaneous itemized deductions. See instructions.
Line 6 . Refund of personal property taxes and real property taxes. See instructions. Do not include your state income tax refund on this line.
Line 7 . Investment interest expense adjustment. See instructions.
Line 8 . Post-1986 depreciation. See instructions.
Line 9 . Adjusted gain or loss. See instructions.
Line 10 . Incentive stock options (I S Os) and California qualified stock options (C Q S Os). See instructions.
Line 11 . Passive activities adjustment. See instructions.
Line 12 . Beneficiaries of estates and trusts. Enter the amount from Schedule K-1 (541), line 12 a.
Line 13 . Other adjustments and preferences. Enter the amount, if any, for each item, a through I. See instructions. Item A. Circulation expenditures.
Item G. Mining costs.
Item B. Depletion.
Item H. Patron’s adjustment.
Item C. Installment sales.
Item I. Pollution control facilities.
Item D. Intangible drilling costs.
Item J. Research and experimental.
Item E. Long-term contracts.
Item K. Tax shelter farm activities.
Item F. Loss limitations.
Item L. Related adjustments.
Line 13 . Add amounts on line a through line l, and enter total here.
Line 14 . Total Adjustments and Preferences. Combine line 1 through line 13 .
Line 15 . Enter taxable income from Form 540, line 19 . See instructions.
Line 16 . Net operating loss (N O L) deductions from Schedule CA (540), Part 1, Section B, line 9b1, line 9b2, and line 9b3, column B. Enter as a positive amount.
Line 17 . A M T I exclusion. See instructions.

Line 18 . If your federal adjusted gross income (A G I) is less than the amount for your filing status (listed below), skip this line and go to line 19 . If you itemized deductions and your federal A G I is more than the amount for your filing status, see instructions. Single or married/Registered Domestic Partner filing separately, $252,203. Married/Registered Domestic Partner filing jointly or qualifying surviving spouse/Registered Domestic Partner $504,411. Head of household, $378,310.
Line 19 . Combine line 14 through line 18 .
Line 20 . Alternative minimum tax N O L deduction. See instructions.
Line 21 . Alternative Minimum Taxable Income. Subtract line 20 from line 19 (if married/Registered Domestic Partner filing separately and line 21 is more than $479,188, see instructions).

Part 2 . Line 22 . Exemption Amount. (If this schedule is for a certain child under age 24, see instructions.) If your filing status is: Single or head of household And line 21 is not over  $347,808, Enter on line 22 $92,749. If your filing status is: Married/Registered Domestic Partner filing jointly or Qualifying Surviving Spouse/Registered Domestic Partner and line 21 is not over $463,745, Enter on line 22 $123,667. If your filing status is: Married/Registered Domestic Partner filing separately and line 21 is not over $231,868, Enter on line 22 $61,830. If Part 1, line 21 is more than the amount shown above for your filing status, see instructions. Enter amount.
Line 23 . Subtract line 22 from line 21 . If zero or less, enter 0 . See instructions.
Line 24 . Tentative Minimum Tax. Multiply line 23 by 7.0% (.07)
Line 25 . Regular tax before credits from Form 540, line 31 .

Line 26 . Alternative Minimum Tax. Subtract line 25 from line 24 . If zero or less, enter 0 here and on Form 540, line 61 . If more than zero, enter here and on Form 540, line 61 . If you make estimated tax payments for taxable year 2026, enter amount from line 26 on the 2026 Form 540-ES, California Estimated Tax Worksheet, line 16 . (Exception: If you have carryover credit for solar energy or commercial solar energy, first enter the result on Side 4, Part 3, Section C, line 23 or 24).
Part 3 . Line 1 . Enter the amount from Form 540, line 35 .
Line 2 . Enter the tentative minimum tax from Part 2, line 24 .
